entry_state: Chapter3 ends by separating a corrected reconstruction from idempotent committed events and unsupported correction journals. Chapter4 has examined accounting dynamics, incomplete databases, provenance, identification, rule languages, extraction and inference. These supply bounded design ideas with explicit transfer limits; blocked foundational papers remain omissions. Sections4.1–4.6 are read;4.7 and the chapter conclusion remain next.

findings.judgment: The literature conclusion connects disclosures, histories, contract states, scenario events, accounting and explanation. It calls this a local integration proposal; originality and comparative practical advantage remain unestablished.

The typed-library/SQL/Python comparator can implement the entire product. DSL maintenance and migration costs remain explicit. Official repository and licence inspection is distinguished from pinned release, integration, distribution and performance evidence; adapters cannot silently mutate the ledger.

Compatibility uses contextual observation operators, justified intervals and joint logical constraints. The suspected rounding cross-reference is a false positive: extracted PDF text and the bound auxiliary file both identify section3.12, the correct rounding discussion. No reference repair is warranted.
